notes: Section-level provenance, not a compound record. Lines 646-656 were read in full, including the [0051] continuation that resumes at 651 after the p11 page break with no marker printed. Almost all of the passage is not chemistry and was excluded: ten Bt gene designations (CrylA(a), CrylA(b), CrylA(c), CryIIA, CrylIIIA, CrylIIIB2, Cry9c, Cry2Ab, Cry3Bb, CrylF) plus the "PAT"-Gen, eleven trade names (YIELD GARD, KnockOut, StarLink, Bollgard, Nucotn, NewLeaf, Roundup Ready, Liberty Link, IMI, STS, Clearfield), the organism Bacillus thuringiensis, the defence terms SAR, Systemin, Phytoalexine and Elicitoren, and every crop and plant name (Weizen, Reis, Soja, Kartoffel, Baumwolle, Raps, Mais, Äpfel, Birnen, Zitrusfrüchte, Weintrauben). Note for a later reader that the gene names print a lower-case l where a capital I is meant, CrylA for CryIA and CrylIIIA for CryIIIA; that is how the source prints them and is not a transcription error here. The four genuine chemical actives named in the passage are recorded above.
